welcome: Welcome to beskid-lings. Fix each exercise until it compiles and its tests pass. Save the file and the runner checks it again. Type h and Enter for a hint.
final: You finished every exercise in beskid-lings. Tell us what was hard.

exercises.name: intro1
exercises.hint: The test calls Answer() and expects 42. Change the value after `return`.

exercises.name: variables1
exercises.hint: The compiler says `count` is immutable. Put `mut` in front of the declaration: `mut i32 count = 0;`.

exercises.name: functions1
exercises.hint: The body already uses `right`, and the test calls `SumOfSquares(3, 4)` with two numbers. Add `i32 right` to the parameter list.

exercises.name: control1
exercises.hint: Add an `else if value == 0` branch that returns "zero". For the sum, remember that `range(1, limit)` stops before `limit`.

exercises.name: types1
exercises.hint: Add `i32 height,` after `i32 width,`, then multiply `this.width` by `this.height` in `Area`.

exercises.name: enums1
exercises.hint: The compiler names the variant that has no arm. A triangle's area is `base * height / 2`.

exercises.name: results1
exercises.hint: In `Divide`, return `Result::Error("cannot divide by zero")` when `divisor == 0`. In `Quarter`, write `?` after `Divide(value, 2)` to get the i32 out of the Result.

exercises.name: collections1
exercises.hint: `Sum` needs `total = total + value;` inside the loop. For `Largest`, start from the first element, `values[0]`, instead of 0.

exercises.name: strings1
exercises.hint: Write `${name}` and `${unread}` inside the string to insert the values. In `IsValidName`, measure `String.Trim(name)` instead of `name`.

exercises.name: lists1
exercises.hint: Add `items.Push("milk");` between the lines that push "bread" and "apples".

exercises.name: move1
exercises.hint: Move the line `i64 count = Array.Len<i64>(scores);` above the `s.Spawn(...)` line, so the scores are counted before `move scores` hands them over.

exercises.name: exchange1
exercises.hint: Make an empty array, `string[] empty = [];`, and return `exchange(this.messages, empty);`.

exercises.name: contracts1
exercises.hint: Copy the shape of `Square.Area`: `pub i32 Area() { return this.width * this.height; }` inside `Rectangle`.

exercises.name: attributes1
exercises.hint: `Order` holds only numbers. Put `[Copyable]` on the line above `type Order`.

exercises.name: fibers1
exercises.hint: Add `Channel.Send<i64>(numbers, 20_i64);` after the first send in `Producer`.

exercises.name: isolates1
exercises.hint: Remove the `counted` variable. Return `UpTo(count).Parallel().Where(...).Map((x) => 1_i64).Reduce(0_i64, SumI64 { })`.

exercises.name: generics1
exercises.hint: Write `<T>` after the name: `T FirstOr<T>(...)`. For `Label`, add `where T: Named` before the opening brace.

exercises.name: generics2
exercises.hint: `Second` must return `B`, the type of `second`. `Swapped` returns `Pair<B, A>`, so its `first` is `this.second` and its `second` is `this.first`.

exercises.name: hosts1
exercises.hint: Add `single PoliteGreeter for Greeter;` as the first line inside `registry { }`.

exercises.name: hosts2
exercises.hint: `BaseHost` registers the clock as `single`. Use `single FixedClock for Clock;` in `AppHost` too.

exercises.name: json1
exercises.hint: Use `Json.AsText(value)` and return the text it gives. Use `Json.Stringify` instead of `Json.Pretty`.

exercises.name: serialization1
exercises.hint: Put `[Serialize]` on the line above `pub type Point`.

exercises.name: network1
exercises.hint: In `RoundTrip`, pass `address` (from `LocalAddress()`) to `TcpStream.Connect`, not `any`.

exercises.name: concurrency1
exercises.hint: Before the `TryReceive` loop, walk `workers` with an index and call `Join()` on each one, as the solution of exercise 15 joins its producer.

exercises.name: hosts3
exercises.hint: The registry says `single PoliteGreeter for Greeter;`, so the service is known as `Greeter`. Change the `startup` parameter to `Greeter greeter`.
